KIDS GAMES · GAME RULES · ACTIVE PLAY

How to Play Balloon Volleyball.

Balloon Volleyball turns a piece of string into a net: tap the balloon over the line, and keep it flying on your side so it never touches the ground.

The card’s three rules

  1. Make a low line across the play area.
  2. Tap the balloon over the line.
  3. Keep the balloon from touching the ground on your side.

Skill practiced: Tap + Cooperate — printed on the card.

What you need

A balloon and a low line — a string between two chairs or a strip of painter’s tape.

For grown-ups

Keep the line low enough that a two-year-old’s tap clears it, and let points go uncounted if counting makes someone cross — the rally is the fun.

Make it fresh tomorrow

Play sitting on the floor for a wobbly, giggly version, or make the line "water" that the balloon must not splash into.
